jobs.title: BACKEND DEVELOPER
Backend Developer (.NET & C++)
jobs.description:
Who We Are
We are looking for a Middle-Senior Backend Developer / Support Engineer to provide L2/L3 engineering support for SAP PowerDesigner. You will investigate complex customer issues, debug and maintain backend components, develop and validate hotfixes, perform root-cause analysis, and contribute targeted product improvements in a long-term enterprise support environment.
You will work in an English-speaking, distributed product-support organization serving SAP stakeholders and enterprise customers. The role combines hands-on backend development with operational support: incident ownership, customer-focused investigation, maintenance engineering, and continuous improvement. Collaboration will span development, support leadership, architecture, and service delivery.
What You'll Be Doing
Analyze and resolve L2/L3 product incidents
Reproduce issues and perform structured root-cause analysis
Debug C#/.NET and C/C++ components
Develop, test, and validate hotfixes and maintenance changes
Investigate customer-reported defects and performance issues
Document findings, fixes, and reusable troubleshooting guidance
Contribute focused feature and product-quality improvements
What You'll Bring Along
BSc/MSc in Computer Science or related field
5-7 years of software development experience
Strong hands-on C# and .NET development skills
Practical C or C++ development and debugging experience
Solid SQL and relational database knowledge
Experience with SAP PowerDesigner
Comfortable owning technical investigations end to end
PowerShell or VBScript scripting skills
Balances code quality with timely incident resolution
Familiarity with data-modelling tools and concepts
Communicates clearly with customers and distributed teams
Enterprise software or product-support experience
Works effectively as an individual contributor
Experience supporting long-lived desktop or backend products
Strong troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving skills
Experience with Agile development methodologies
Good written and spoken English communication skills

jobs.title: CC Digital Services_SW 2_Deutsche Bank_Backend Engineer Genesys
jobs.description:
Who We Are
Within the Contact Center (CC) and Remote Banking (RBC) environment, we are responsible for developing and operating a highly available, omnichannel-enabled contact center infrastructure based on Genesys. This platform connects backend systems with customer-facing channels in an efficient and secure way while meeting all relevant regulatory requirements.
For this business-critical platform, we are looking for a Backend Engineer who combines strong technical expertise with a clear sense of product ownership, with a particular focus on the Genesys CC platform, system integrations, and operational resilience.
What You’ll Be Doing
Technical Engineering & Platform Ownership
Contributing to the development and continuous enhancement of an AI-enabled, multichannel contact center platform (Genesys)
Designing and implementing backend services, APIs, and integrations between the CC platform and banking systems
Taking ownership of the infrastructure’s scalability, high availability, and security
Enhancing SIP/VoIP, routing, and integration architectures
Ensuring code quality, CI/CD, automated testing, and stable deployments
Providing third-level support for critical production incidents
Managing end-to-end implementations from design and development through testing to go-live
Coordinating closely with external service providers and internal stakeholders
Ensuring compliance with regulatory and governance requirements
Playing an active role in architecture boards and technical decision-making processes
Driving innovation and the continuous evolution of the platform
Stakeholder Collaboration & Teamwork: Working closely with Product Owners, Architecture teams, Operations teams (SRE / Operations), External implementation partners
Translating business requirements into effective technical solutions
What We’re Looking For
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field
At least 4y+ of experience in working with Java, Spring Boot
Hands-on engineering experience in contact center solutions, ideally Genesys, SIP, VoIP, routing, and omnichannel platforms
Strong knowledge of: Backend development, e.g. Java and Spring Boot, API design and system integration
Strong knowledge of: Database technologies, particularly Oracle
Practical experience with: Unix/Linux systems, Web servers such as Apache and Tomcat, CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
Solid understanding of: Networking and security, including TLS and encryption, high-availability and scaling architectures
Nice To Have
Experience with AI-enabled cloud contact center solutions
Knowledge of working in regulated environments, ideally within banking
Experience with cloud platforms, preferably GCP
Experience with observability, monitoring, and KPI management

jobs.title: Full Stack Java Developer
jobs.description:
Project description
VR-124185
Our Client is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Their purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
Team is seeking a highly technical, hands-on Java developer. Our group is focused on bringing a new level of efficiency, transparency and openness to the trading process by building a collaborative community of investors, brokers, technology firms and content providers.
Through our modular, end-to-end trade management platform, users can: execute everything from simple single stock trades to complex strategies across markets and time zones and manage their risk throughout the trade lifecycle; access our growing network of execution brokers to route Equities, Futures or Options orders globally, as well as dozens of integrated prime and clearing brokers through our growing suite of middle office tools; and collaborate with our broker and vendor partners, who are able to efficiently plug into our platform to reach our community.
This role involves maintenance and enhancement of existing backend and web-based applications, and contributing to the evolution of our trading platform and web user interfaces.
Responsibilities
Contributes to design, development, and implementation of backend services and web applications.
Writes clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following established engineering practices.
Participates in technical design discussions and collaborates with senior engineers and architects.
Works closely with frontend developers to integrate backend services with UI components.
Supports troubleshooting, debugging, and performance optimization of applications.
Breaks down user stories into technical tasks and delivers within agreed timelines.
Collaborates effectively in Agile teams with product owners, QA, and other developers.
Maintains and improves existing systems while ensuring stability and reliability.
Builds positive relationships within the team and contributes to a collaborative environment.
Communicates technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Continuously develops technical expertise and stays up to date with modern technologies and frameworks.
Skills
Must have
Strong Java fundamentals (Java 21 preferred) including core concepts (collections, concurrency, memory management).
Solid experience with Spring Framework (Spring 4+) and Spring Boot 3.x.
Experience building and consuming REST APIs.
Good knowledge of React (version 17) and integration with backend services.
Strong understanding of web application architecture and client-server communication.
Experience with SQL and relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL).
Proficiency with version control (Git) and build tools (Maven/Gradle).
Strong focus on clean code, unit testing, and code reviews.
Familiar with Agile development practices.
Comfortable working in Linux/Unix environments.
5-8+ years of software engineering experience.
Experience with trading platforms is preferred; however, candidates with broader financial services systems experience will also be considered.
Nice to have
Experience with JSF / JSP applications and legacy UI technologies.
Familiarity with modern frontend practices and component-based architectures.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and testing practices.
Exposure to Docker / containerization.
Basic understanding of distributed systems.
Familiarity with Spring ecosystem tooling.
Knowledge of financial systems or trading platforms is a plus.
BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent software engineering qualification.
